narrative.overview: A ranked editorial queue and source-bearing comparison document.

rules.name: Evidence before verdict
rules.body: Similarity and matching dates do not establish full-claim truth.

dos: Keep the current queue rank visible.
Use real excerpts to distinguish passages.
donts: Do not hide exact revision actions in tiny text.
Do not place status tags above headings as eyebrows.
